name: NoVAFamilyClearingAHouse

custom.system_prompt: Nora and Alex clear a late aunt's house. A charity-collection question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a fire label, the booking email, or a neighbour.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Old house interior, boxes, a wardrobe door, newspaper crumpled, a radio not switched on, birds outside a window.

initial_prompt: Generate a long, natural conversation between Nora and Alex clearing the house of Nora's late aunt on a Saturday. The work is slow because everything has a story. They talk about the aunt and things Nora is only learning now, whether Alex should take the Head of Department job, a photograph neither can identify, how much they can throw away. Nora wonders if the charity shop takes furniture and Alex says they take anything. They find a box of letters and keep it unread. Later the sofa and the Monday collection matter because handover is Friday. This time it resolves without Sigma: the fire label is still attached, or the booking email states it, or a neighbour offers the council number. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple clearing a late relative's house. The charity-collection uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Quiet, slow, affectionate grief under an ordinary practical task.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Nora is the one connected to the house; Alex is careful and useful and says less than usual. Four years together.
setting.background: The house has been empty three months. Handover on Friday. Collection booked Monday.
setting.conversation_style: Slow, digressive, frequently stopped by an object. Long pauses implied.

scenario_template.topic: Which room to start with and how much there is.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: The fire label is still stitched to the sofa and answers it.
The charity's booking email states the requirement clearly.
A neighbour who has done this offers the council uplift number.
Nora rings the charity and gets a straight answer.
They decide on a skip regardless and stop thinking about it.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: The aunt and things Nora is only learning now
A photograph neither of them can identify
Whether Alex should take the Head of Department job
How much of this they are allowed to simply throw away
The book Nora wants to commission
Whether they would want a house like this
task_details: Newspaper from 1998 used as drawer lining
A wardrobe that will not stay shut
Bin bags that are the wrong size
A box labelled in handwriting neither recognises
A radio that has not been switched on
realism_devices: An object stops the work entirely for a while.
Alex makes a confident historical claim about a piece of furniture.
Nora starts a sentence about her aunt and does not finish it.
They both reach into the same drawer.
They declare a room done and open one more cupboard.
A long pause where neither speaks.

user1.name: Nora
user1.role: Development editor. Observant and detail-attentive, recognises things reliably but is unreliable with names and titles.

user2.name: Alex
user2.role: History teacher. Large general knowledge deployed with more confidence than accuracy — often in the right neighbourhood, rarely exactly right.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Objects should repeatedly stop the practical work.
At least 50% of turns should be personal conversation.
Alex's initial assumption must not lead to Sigma.
At least one decision must be made without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The clearing must be nowhere near finished at the end.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should be ordinary conversation.
The collection question should appear at least five turns before the Sigma request.
Grief should be present without being stated directly.
At least one decision should be made without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The ending should leave the house largely unsorted.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
